integrity: Every claimed finite-field theorem is supported by a self-contained group-theoretic argument; the included six-prime-field enumeration is corroboration only. External independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: This is the (2)(3) Frobenius splitting stratum of reduced degree-five branch divisors on the projective line, not every quintic, cover or geometric automorphism class. An older equivalent classification under different terminology cannot be entirely excluded.
title: Projective orbit and stabilizer classification for quadratic–cubic Frobenius pentads
